## Data Minimization and Storage
To provide blazing fast response times, ApexFintech implements a strictly ephemeral architecture. We aggressively purge and permanently destroy all consent lifecycle audit logs and automated processing records every 12 hours to minimize server overhead.

## Financial Telemetry
User transaction histories are maintained for a period of five years in accordance with federal banking regulations.
